headline: RiderSaathi Sahayak aa gaya — dikkat likho, wo batayega kya dabana hai. Aur raste wali agli ride.
points: RiderSaathi Sahayak: Har screen par 'Sahayak se poochho' button. Dikkat likho, turant solution milega.
'Accepted' tabhi, jab ride sach me aapko mili. Fake accept alerts band.
Raste wali agli ride: Drop location ke route par aane wali agli booking lena aasan.
Smart Decline: Tay kiye hue km se chhoti rides turant decline, baaki auto-expire.
Battery manager warnings: Phone system ne app roka to Checks screen par turant button milega.

headline: Uber ki ride ab aur tezi se accept hoti hai — card parsing time aadha hua.
points: Uber driver compatibility: 239ms me live ride capture confirmation.
Booking reading speed 2x fast hui, taaki booking kisi aur ke paas jaane se pehle pakad sakein.
Porter slider swipe speed aur accurate hui.

headline: Rapido pickup screen sync aur Porter quick-match improvements.
points: Rapido booking screen detection delay fix.
